author: DiscussingFilm
text:
Director Lance Oppenheim says Nathan Fielder helped him a lot behind the scenes of ‘PRIMETIME’.

“I would show [Nathan] works in progress. I would talk to him all the time about Robert’s performance. I would talk to him about ways in which we can tune the machine a little bit.”
